title: AMERICA'S
10 BIGGEST
CITIES

hook.say: America's ten biggest cities, ranked. Four of them are in Texas!

outro.say: Is your city on the list? Comment below!

items.name: Fort Worth
items.say: Number ten: Fort Worth, brand new to the top ten. Just over 1 million people.
items.cap: Number ten: Fort Worth, brand new to the top ten. Just over 1 million people.

items.name: Dallas
items.say: Nine: Dallas, just thirty miles down the road. One-point-three million people.
items.cap: Nine: Dallas, just thirty miles down the road. 1.3 million people.

items.name: San Diego
items.say: Eight: San Diego, right on the Mexican border. One-point-four million people.
items.cap: Eight: San Diego, right on the Mexican border. 1.4 million people.

items.name: San Antonio
items.say: Seven: San Antonio, home of the Alamo. One-point-five million people.
items.cap: Seven: San Antonio, home of the Alamo. 1.5 million people.

items.name: Philadelphia
items.say: Six: Philadelphia, where America was born. One-point-six million people.
items.cap: Six: Philadelphia, where America was born. 1.6 million people.

items.name: Phoenix
items.say: Five: Phoenix, a giant in the desert. One-point-seven million people.
items.cap: Five: Phoenix, a giant in the desert. 1.7 million people.

items.name: Houston
items.say: Four: Houston, the Space City. Two-point-four million people.
items.cap: Four: Houston, the Space City. 2.4 million people.

items.name: Chicago
items.say: Three: Chicago, the Windy City. Two-point-seven million people.
items.cap: Three: Chicago, the Windy City. 2.7 million people.

items.name: Los Angeles
items.say: Two: Los Angeles, the City of Angels. Three-point-nine million people.
items.cap: Two: Los Angeles, the City of Angels. 3.9 million people.

items.name: New York City
items.say: And number one: New York City! Eight-point-six million people, more than double Los Angeles.
items.cap: And number one: New York City! 8.6 million people, more than double Los Angeles.
